root.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T.OWNER 소유자 ,T.TABLE_NAME 테이블명 ,C.COLUMN_NAME 칼럼명 ,TC.COMMENTS 테이블한글명 ,CC.COMMENTS 칼럼한글명명 FROM DBA_TABLES T INNER JOIN DBA_TAB_COLS C ON (T.OWNER = C.OWNER AND T.TABLE_NAME = C.TABLE_NAME ) LEFT OUTER JOIN DBA_TAB_COMMENTS TC ON ( T.OWNER = TC.OWNER AND T.TABLE_NAME = TC.TABLE_NAME ) LEFT OUTER JOIN DBA_COL_COMMENTS CC ON ( C.TABLE_NAME = CC.TABLE_NAME AND C.OWNER = CC.OWNER AND C.COLUMN_NAME = CC.COLUMN_NAME ) ) WHERE 소유자 IN ( SELECT CONF_VALUE FROM DQ.DQ$CONF WHERE CONF_GBN ='TARGET_OWNER' )

SELECT A.* , ROUND( 테이블한글명누락/테이블개수 * 100,2) "테이블한글명누락율(%)" , ROUND( 칼럼한글명누락/칼럼개수 * 100,2) "칼럼한글명누락율(%)" FROM ( SELECT OWNER 소유자 ,COUNT( DISTINCT OWNER || TABLE_NAME ) 테이블개수 ,COUNT( DISTINCT OWNER || TABLE_NAME ||COLUMN_NAME) 칼럼개수 ,COUNT( CASE WHEN RN_TBL = 1 AND T_COMMENTS IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) 테이블한글명누락 ,COUNT( CASE WHEN C_COMMENTS IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) 칼럼한글명누락 FROM ( SELECT T.OWNER ,T.TABLE_NAME ,C.COLUMN_NAME ,TC.COMMENTS T_COMMENTS ,CC.COMMENTS C_COMMENTS ,ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY T.OWNER, T.TABLE_NAME ORDER BY 1) RN_TBL FROM DBA_TABLES T INNER JOIN DBA_TAB_COLS C ON (T.OWNER = C.OWNER AND T.TABLE_NAME = C.TABLE_NAME ) LEFT OUTER JOIN DBA_TAB_COMMENTS TC ON ( T.OWNER = TC.OWNER AND T.TABLE_NAME = TC.TABLE_NAME ) LEFT OUTER JOIN DBA_COL_COMMENTS CC ON ( C.TABLE_NAME = CC.TABLE_NAME AND C.OWNER = CC.OWNER AND C.COLUMN_NAME = CC.COLUMN_NAME ) ) WHERE OWNER IN ( SELECT CONF_VALUE FROM DQ$CONF WHERE CONF_GBN ='TARGET_OWNER' ) GROUP BY OWNER ) A

/* 테이블목록 */ SELECT T.OWNER 소유자 ,T.TAB_NM 테이블명 ,CMT.COMMENT_CURRENT 테이블한글명 ,T.ROW_CNT 데이터건수 ,T.USE_AT 테이블사용여부 ,T.RM 테이블미사용사유 FROM DQ$TAB T LEFT OUTER JOIN DQ$COMMENTS CMT ON ( T.TAB_NM = CMT.TAB_NM AND T.OWNER = CMT.OWNER AND CMT.OBJ_TYPE ='TABLE' )

/* 칼럼목록 */ SELECT TC.OWNER 소유자 ,TC.TAB_NM 테이블명 ,TCMT.COMMENT_CURRENT 테이블한글명 ,TC.COL_NM 칼럼명 ,CCMT.COMMENT_CURRENT 칼럼한글명 ,TC.ROW_CNT 데이터건수
,TC.T_USE_AT 테이블사용여부 ,TC.T_RM 테이블미사용사유 ,TC.C_USE_AT 칼럼사용여부 ,TC.C_RM 칼럼미사용사유 FROM (SELECT T.OWNER ,T.TAB_NM ,T.TAB_ID ,T.USE_AT T_USE_AT ,T.ROW_CNT ,T.RM T_RM ,C.COL_ID ,C.COL_NM ,C.USE_AT C_USE_AT ,C.RM C_RM FROM DQ$TAB T INNER JOIN DQ$TAB_COLS C ON ( T.TAB_ID = C.TAB_ID ) ) TC LEFT OUTER JOIN DQ$COMMENTS TCMT ON ( TC.TAB_NM = TCMT.TAB_NM AND TC.OWNER = TCMT.OWNER AND TCMT.OBJ_TYPE ='TABLE') LEFT OUTER JOIN DQ$COMMENTS CCMT ON ( TC.TAB_NM = CCMT.TAB_NM AND TC.OWNER = CCMT.OWNER AND TC.COL_NM = CCMT.COL_NM AND CCMT.OBJ_TYPE ='COLUMN')
/* 분석 대상 테이블 칼럼 */ SELECT T.OWNER 소유자 ,T.TAB_NM 테이블명 ,C.COL_NM 칼럼명 ,T.USE_AT 테이블사용여부 ,T.RM 테이블미사용사유 ,C.USE_AT 칼럼사용여부 ,C.RM 칼럼미사용사유 FROM DQ$TAB T INNER JOIN DQ$TAB_COLS C ON ( T.TAB_ID = C.TAB_ID )

/* 분석 규칙 적용 칼럼 */ SELECT T.OWNER 소유자 ,T.TAB_NM 테이블명 ,C.COL_NM 칼럼명 --,T.ROW_CNT 데이터건수 --,T.USE_AT 테이블사용여부 --,T.RM 테이블미사용사유 --,C.USE_AT 칼럼사용여부 --,C.RM 칼럼미사용사유 ,V.VLD_TYPE 도메인 ,V.VLD_RANGE 적용패턴 FROM DQ$TAB T INNER JOIN DQ$TAB_COLS C ON ( T.TAB_ID = C.TAB_ID ) LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CV.COL_ID ,V.VLD_GBN ,V.VLD_TYPE ,V.VLD_RANGE FROM DQ$TAB_COLS_VLD CV INNER JOIN DQ$VLD V ON ( CV.VLD_ID = V.VLD_ID ) ) V ON ( C.COL_ID = V.COL_ID) WHERE T.USE_AT ='Y' AND C.USE_AT ='Y'

SELECT T.OWNER 소유자 ,T.TAB_NM 테이블명 ,C.COL_NM 칼럼명 ,C.COL_ID 칼럼ID ,V.VLD_ID 검증ID ,V.VLD_GBN 도메인 ,V.VLD_RANGE 적용패턴 ,V.TOT 검사건수 ,V.FCNT 오류건수 ,V.NCNT 널건수 ,TO_CHAR( DECODE ( TOT,NULL,NULL ,0,0,ROUND(V.FCNT/V.TOT * 100 ,2) ),'FM900.00') 오류율 ,DR.TOP_VALS 상위분포 ,DR.BTM_VALS 하위분포 ,ERR.TOP_ERRS 오류상위분포 ,ERR.BTM_ERRS 오류하위분포
FROM DQ$TAB T INNER JOIN DQ$TAB_COLS C ON ( T.TAB_ID = C.TAB_ID ) LEFT OUTER JOIN STAT$DSTB_RSLT DR ON ( C.COL_ID = DR.COL_ID ) LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CV.COL_ID ,V.VLD_ID ,V.VLD_GBN ,V.VLD_TYPE ,V.VLD_RANGE ,TOT ,TCNT ,FCNT ,NCNT FROM DQ$TAB_COLS_VLD CV INNER JOIN DQ$VLD V ON ( CV.VLD_ID = V.VLD_ID ) INNER JOIN STAT$VLD_SMMY RSLT ON ( CV.COL_ID = RSLT.COL_ID AND CV.VLD_ID = RSLT.VLD_ID ) ) V ON ( C.COL_ID = V.COL_ID) LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COL_ID,VLD_ID ,LISTAGG ( CASE WHEN RN_DESC <= 10 THEN ERR_DATA ||'('||TO_CHAR(ERR_CNT)||')' ELSE NULL END ,' / ' ) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RN_DESC ) TOP_ERRS ,LISTAGG ( CASE WHEN RN_ASC <= 10 THEN ERR_DATA ||'('||TO_CHAR(ERR_CNT)||')' ELSE NULL END ,' / ' ) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RN_DESC ) BTM_ERRS FROM (select COL_ID,VLD_ID ,ERR_DATA,ERR_CNT ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY COL_ID,VLD_ID ORDER BY ERR_CNT DESC ) RN_DESC ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY COL_ID,VLD_ID ORDER BY ERR_CNT ASC ) RN_ASC from STAT$VLD_ERR_DATA) GROUP BY COL_ID,VLD_ID) ERR ON ( V.COL_ID = ERR.COL_ID AND V.VLD_ID = ERR.VLD_ID ) WHERE T.USE_AT ='Y' AND C.USE_AT ='Y'

/* 분석 결과 통계 (테이블) */ SELECT 소유자 ,테이블명 ,COUNT(DISTINCT COL_ID) 칼럼개수 ,COUNT(DISTINCT COL_ID||VLD_ID) 적용규칙개수 ,COUNT(DISTINCT 적용패턴 ) 적용패턴건수 ,SUM(검사건수) 검사건수 ,SUM(오류건수) 오류건수 ,SUM(널건수) 널건수 ,TO_CHAR(DECODE ( SUM(검사건수),NULL,NULL ,0,0,ROUND(SUM(오류건수)/SUM(검사건수) * 100 ,2) ),'FM900.00') 오류율 FROM (SELECT T.TAB_ID ,C.COL_ID ,V.VLD_ID , T.OWNER 소유자 , T.TAB_NM 테이블명 ,C.COL_NM 칼럼명 ,V.VLD_GBN 도메인 ,V.VLD_RANGE 적용패턴 ,V.TOT 검사건수 ,V.FCNT 오류건수 ,V.NCNT 널건수 ,TO_CHAR(DECODE ( TOT,NULL,NULL ,0,0,ROUND(V.FCNT/V.TOT * 100 ,2) ),'FM900.00') 오류율
FROM DQ$TAB T INNER JOIN DQ$TAB_COLS C ON ( T.TAB_ID = C.TAB_ID ) LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CV.COL_ID ,V.VLD_ID ,V.VLD_GBN ,V.VLD_TYPE ,V.VLD_RANGE ,TOT ,TCNT ,FCNT ,NCNT FROM DQ$TAB_COLS_VLD CV INNER JOIN DQ$VLD V ON ( CV.VLD_ID = V.VLD_ID ) INNER JOIN STAT$VLD_SMMY RSLT ON ( CV.COL_ID = RSLT.COL_ID AND CV.VLD_ID = RSLT.VLD_ID ) ) V ON ( C.COL_ID = V.COL_ID) WHERE T.USE_AT ='Y' AND C.USE_AT ='Y') GROUP BY 소유자, 테이블명

/* 분석 결과 통계 (전체) */ SELECT CASE WHEN OWNER IS NOT NULL THEN '소유자별' WHEN DOMAIN IS NOT NULL THEN '도메인별' ELSE '총계' END 구분
,NVL(OWNER, DOMAIN) 분석대상
,COUNT(DISTINCT TAB_ID) 테이블개수 ,COUNT(DISTINCT COL_ID) 칼럼개수 ,COUNT(DISTINCT COL_ID||VLD_ID) 적용규칙개수 ,COUNT(DISTINCT VLD_RANGE ) 적용패턴건수 ,SUM(TOT) 검사건수 ,SUM(FCNT) 오류건수 ,SUM(NCNT) 널건수 ,TO_CHAR(DECODE ( SUM(TOT),NULL,NULL ,0,0,ROUND(SUM(FCNT)/SUM(TOT) * 100 ,2) ) ,'FM900.00') "오류율(%)" FROM (SELECT T.TAB_ID ,C.COL_ID ,V.VLD_ID , T.OWNER , T.TAB_NM ,C.COL_NM ,V.VLD_GBN DOMAIN ,V.VLD_RANGE ,V.TOT ,V.FCNT ,V.NCNT ,DECODE ( TOT,NULL,NULL ,0,0,ROUND(V.FCNT/V.TOT * 100 ,2) ) ERR_RATE
FROM DQ$TAB T INNER JOIN DQ$TAB_COLS C ON ( T.TAB_ID = C.TAB_ID ) INNER JOIN (SELECT CV.COL_ID ,V.VLD_ID ,V.VLD_GBN ,V.VLD_TYPE ,V.VLD_RANGE ,TOT ,TCNT ,FCNT ,NCNT FROM DQ$TAB_COLS_VLD CV INNER JOIN DQ$VLD V ON ( CV.VLD_ID = V.VLD_ID AND V.USE_AT ='Y' AND CV.USE_AT ='Y') LEFT OUTER JOIN STAT$VLD_SMMY RSLT ON ( CV.COL_ID = RSLT.COL_ID AND CV.VLD_ID = RSLT.VLD_ID ) ) V ON ( C.COL_ID = V.COL_ID) WHERE T.USE_AT ='Y' AND C.USE_AT ='Y') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( ROLLUP(OWNER), DOMAIN)

SELECT OWNER 소유자 ,TAB_NM 테이블명 ,T_COMMENTS 테이블한글명 ,COL_NM 칼럼명 ,C_COMMENTS 칼럼한글명 ,VLD_GBN 검사도메인 ,VLD_RANGE 검사값 ,ERR_DATA 오류값 ,ERR_CNT 오류값개수 FROM( SELECT COL.OWNER ,COL.TAB_NM ,COL.T_COMMENTS ,COL.COL_NM ,COL.C_COMMENTS ,VLD_GBN ,VLD.VLD_RANGE ,ERR.ERR_DATA ,ERR.ERR_CNT FROM STAT$VLD_ERR_DATA ERR INNER JOIN V_TAB_COL_LIST COL ON (ERR.COL_ID = COL.COL_ID) INNER JOIN DQ$VLD VLD ON (ERR.VLD_ID = VLD.VLD_ID) ) ORDER BY OWNER , TAB_NM, COL_NM,ERR_CNT
